1 [[Plant Fiber]] | collector = [[Chef Volon]] }} [[Iboga Petal]]s are a type of [[trophy]] item that [[drop]]s from various [[Iboga]] throughout [[Elona]]. They are the leafy remains of the sentient Iboga that wander the island of [[Istan]]. They have spicy taste and often cause immediate nausea. Despite this, these leaves are a key ingredient in [[Pahnai Salad]], and so are prized by chefs. However, the obvious danger inherent in harvesting Iboga petals makes Pahnai Salad a rare treat at best. They are also often used in sandwiches. ==Acquisition== * [[Nightfall]] ** [[Istan]] *** [[Beautiful Iboga]] *** [[Fanged Iboga]] *** [[Iboga Root]] *** [[Killer Iboga]] ** [[Kourna]] *** [[Mirage Iboga]] *** [[Vicious Seedling (mesmer)]] ** [[Vabbi]] *** Mirage Iboga ''Drop and salvage research is ongoing, and can be found [[Talk:Iboga Petal#Drop research|here]].'' ===Farming=== ====[[Plains of Jarin]]==== Run by the edges of the explorable area. Start from [[Kamadan]] and finish halfway at [[The Astralarium]]. You can go either northwards or southwards. ====[[Cliffs of Dohjok]]==== (Nightfall character only method) Use the quest [[Scholarly Affairs]] to spawn [[Beautiful Iboga]]. Upon entering Cliffs of Dohjok do not talk to Zerai and go kill the Beautiful Iboga along the northern edge of the map. They drop [[Iboga Blossom]]s which you do not need if you are farming petals so ignore them. They also drop Iboga Petals so as long as you do not complete the quest you can repeat the farm. It is a secondary quest and as such is not necessary to advance the Nightfall storyline. ==Collectors== {{:Chef Volon/Collector}} [[Category:Contains dust]] [[Category:Contains fiber]]
